text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_thermal_stability_sweep_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_srv","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"plate_srv","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate for OER screening"},{"server":"synth_srv","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,10],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCoZn oxide precursor film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synth_srv","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":180,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step per spinel phase protocol; routine thermal treatment"},{"server":"echem_srv","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":0,"y":0},"comment":"locate deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_srv","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,10],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at standard OER current density"},{"server":"model_srv","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"update GP surrogate with new overpotential point"},{"server":"echem_srv","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,10],"duration":12},"comment":"short stability check"}]}
